name: strategy
description: Vintage, roll-rate, profitability, governed sample design, univariate, automatic-tree, Voting n-of-k, and complete two-dimensional Cross Matrix candidate development with explicit leaf and Cross cell-group materialization, Strategy Pool assembly, unified deterministic ImpactCube and independent validation/OOT replay evidence, strategy construction, deterministic application, backtesting, and tradeoff analysis tools.

tools.name: vintage_curve
tools.summary: Compute a strategy-facing vintage curve from the shared deterministic vintage core.

tools.name: roll_rate_matrix
tools.summary: Compute a roll-rate transition matrix from customer status sequences.

tools.name: profit_calc
tools.summary: Calculate deterministic segment profitability from EAD, PD, and cost parameters.

tools.name: analyze_univariate_candidates
tools.summary: Deterministically analyze bounded numeric and categorical fields, preserve canonical bin conditions, and emit development-only candidate evidence with JSON/XLSX reports.

tools.name: build_automatic_tree_candidate
tools.summary: Build one complete deterministic weighted rule-tree candidate from the current task-owned labelled dataset and publish canonical JSON, Python, DuckDB SQL, SVG, PNG, and XLSX deliveries after bounded execution-equivalence checks.

tools.name: apply_automatic_tree
tools.summary: Verify a current-task canonical automatic-tree asset and its original active dataset/workspace, deterministically append complete leaf/rule assignments, then atomically register governed dataset and evidence facts with explicit optional workspace activation.

tools.name: materialize_automatic_tree_leaf_fragment
tools.summary: Verify one live task-owned canonical automatic-tree artifact and persist an explicit pointer-only leaf selection without copying rules, metrics, actions, or admitting it to a Strategy Pool.

tools.name: build_voting_candidate
tools.summary: Build one deterministic development-only n-of-k Voting candidate from an exact current Strategy Pool revision, replay its immutable member conditions on their shared labelled sample, and publish one canonical JSON artifact without changing the Pool or applying, adopting, or deploying the candidate.

tools.name: build_cross_matrix_candidate
tools.summary: Replay two explicit axes from one exact task-owned univariate evidence artifact, measure every Cartesian cell once on its immutable labelled sample, and publish one complete development-only two-dimensional Cross Matrix JSON asset without selecting cells, changing a Strategy Pool, writing back data, adopting, or deploying.

tools.name: materialize_cross_matrix_cell_selection
tools.summary: Verify one live task-owned canonical Cross Matrix asset and persist one explicit pointer-only non-empty cell group in source row-major order, without ranking cells, copying predicates or metrics, changing a Strategy Pool, applying, adopting, or deploying anything.

tools.name: refine_univariate_candidate
tools.summary: Replay task-owned univariate evidence, apply explicit bin merges and deterministic selection, and emit an immutable development-only candidate asset.

tools.name: add_candidate_to_pool
tools.summary: Add one immutable task-owned refined univariate asset, persisted automatic-tree leaf selection, persisted Cross Matrix cell selection, or verified Voting n-of-k candidate to a draft Strategy Pool revision after strict evidence, dataset, ancestry, and optimistic-lock validation; Voting requires explicit before-selected-members insertion or atomic member replacement and can never use ordinary append.

tools.name: remove_pool_entry
tools.summary: Remove one Strategy Pool membership by stable rule_id and persist a new draft revision; no strategy is adopted or deployed.

tools.name: set_pool_entry_action
tools.summary: Replace the Pool-owned typed action for one stable rule_id and persist a new draft revision.

tools.name: reorder_strategy_pool
tools.summary: Persist one complete, duplicate-free stable rule_id ordering as a new draft Strategy Pool revision.

tools.name: compile_strategy_pool
tools.summary: Compile an exact current Strategy Pool revision to canonical StrategySpec and SelectedStrategyDesign hashes without dataset execution, persistence, adoption, or deployment.

tools.name: materialize_project_context
tools.summary: Discover and bind governed current-project, historical-strategy and missing-information evidence into an immutable task-owned revision.

tools.name: materialize_sample_design
tools.summary: Freeze the exact active task dataset, target semantics, windows, maturity, optional split, and metric coverage as an immutable development-only StrategySampleDesign artifact.

tools.name: materialize_sample_design_v2
tools.summary: Freeze exact approval and risk populations across development, validation, and OOT partitions as an authenticated V2 sample bundle plus row-membership artifact.

tools.name: materialize_model_evidence_v2
tools.summary: Translate authenticated task-owned univariate candidate artifacts into one immutable Strategy ModelEvidence V2 bundle without accepting caller-computed metrics.

tools.name: measure_pool_impact
tools.summary: Measure immutable first-match, risk, amount, monthly, and optional same-task baseline evidence for the exact current approval/reject Strategy Pool revision.

tools.name: measure_candidate_monthly_stability
tools.summary: Measure immutable monthly hit-distribution PSI for one exact refined univariate asset or one exact current Strategy Pool entry on its governed development sample.

tools.name: measure_strategy_pool_validation
tools.summary: Replay the exact compiled current approval/reject Strategy Pool on the authenticated StrategySampleDesign V2 risk validation or OOT membership and publish immutable aggregate-only independent evidence.

tools.name: measure_strategy_impact_cube
tools.summary: Measure one exact current Strategy Pool across separately governed approval and risk partitions and publish immutable aggregate-only ImpactSlice and ImpactCube evidence for all five typed strategy families.

tools.name: export_strategy_delivery
tools.summary: Export one exact task-owned strategy as standalone Python, DuckDB SQL, and canonical JSON, then publish deterministic equivalence evidence over an explicitly bounded sample without applying, adopting, or deploying it.

tools.name: build_report_bundle_v2
tools.summary: Build and atomically publish deterministic JSON, Markdown, Excel, and Word StrategyReportBundle projections with exact ImpactCube-first evidence and approval/reject-only legacy PoolImpact fallback.

tools.name: design_strategy_candidate
tools.summary: Deterministically design a limit, pricing, or segmentation candidate from a task-owned dataset and bounded user search inputs.

tools.name: build_strategy
tools.summary: Validate and persist a deterministic strategy rule set.

tools.name: apply_strategy
tools.summary: Apply a persisted canonical strategy to a task-owned dataset and atomically register deterministic per-row actions as a derived dataset.

tools.name: backtest_strategy
tools.summary: Backtest a persisted strategy on a dataset and persist aggregate results.

tools.name: tradeoff_view
tools.summary: Scan score cutoffs and recommend an operating point under risk constraints.

tools.name: design_cutoff_bands
tools.summary: Split scores into deterministic bands and recommend a monotone approve/decline cut under risk constraints.

tools.name: compare_strategies
tools.summary: Compare a candidate strategy against a baseline on a dataset with a 2x2 agreement matrix and deltas.

tools.name: adopt_strategy
tools.summary: Adopt a task-bound approval, reject, limit, pricing, or segmentation strategy behind a mandatory confirmation gate; emit aggregate audit evidence, a decision table, and a type-specific monitoring plan.

band_stats.description: Deprecated stored-plan compatibility input. Adoption ignores these unbound caller statistics and derives deliverables only from persisted strategy/backtest evidence.

lifecycle_notice.const: 本地已采纳，不代表生产上线。

tools.name: render_strategy_doc
tools.summary: Render a Chinese-language strategy markdown document from persisted strategy, backtests, and artifacts.

tools.name: mine_rules
tools.summary: Mine deterministic candidate reject rules from a labeled sample via decision-tree paths and univariate cutpoints.

tools.name: evaluate_rule_set
tools.summary: Evaluate an ordered rule subset with a first-match-wins waterfall, overlap matrix, and residual/combined stats.

tools.name: select_rule_set
tools.summary: Assemble the user-selected ordered subset of mined candidate rules into a gate payload.

tools.name: run_strategy_monitoring
tools.summary: Run one evidence-bound monitoring pass for a locally adopted strategy asset: model PSI/CSI when model-backed plus type-specific strategy and economics checks, persisted to the immutable monitoring plan/run ledger; local adoption does not imply production deployment.

tools.name: apply_monitoring_disposition
tools.summary: Apply a human-confirmed response to the latest evidence-bound monitoring run: acknowledge a non-red run, record observe for red, atomically rerun a validated threshold revision, or create a real draft strategy task/version from red evidence.

tools.name: render_monitoring_report
tools.summary: Render an immutable content-addressed Markdown report from a verified monitoring-run ledger entry and its hash-bound executed disposition receipt; caller-supplied verdicts, checks and handoff claims are not accepted.

tools.name: limit_pricing_matrix
tools.summary: Deterministic band x limit x rate expected-profit grid with EL simulation; exports task-owned CSV and Markdown only after the matrix confirmation gate.

tools.name: render_challenger_report
tools.summary: Assemble a challenger-vs-champion Markdown report from task-owned persisted strategies and a challenger backtest receipt; recomputes report evidence and canonical local-adoption status. No-op when no champion is supplied.
